blocks.text:
Slide a finger along the dock and the icon under it grows, with its neighbours rising behind it and settling again as you move, so the dock swells around wherever you are.

The icon under your finger reaches about a third again its size, and the ones beside it rise a little, less the further away they are. Icons grow toward the screen rather than toward the edge they sit on, so none of them is ever clipped, and a small tick marks the moment you cross from one to the next. The dock along the bottom and the side dock the inner screen uses both do it.

Nothing about opening an app changes: a finger passing over the dock opens nothing, and lifting it on an icon opens that app as before.

Like every tweak it has its own page in Settings › Tweaks, with a switch for the cover screen and a switch for the inner one, so it can be on where it helps and off where it doesn't.

Inspired by Harbor by Evan Swick. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.

items: Icons grow about a third under your finger
Neighbours follow, and settle when you lift off
They grow toward the screen, never off the edge
A tick as you cross from one icon to the next
The bottom dock and the side dock

entries.notes: Harborline becomes a package in the Folio Market. The tweak itself has shipped with Folio since 0.6.0.
